hint.en: PELS runs the device in the cheapest hours before the ready-by time, within the hard cap and, unless you allow more, the daily budget, until it has taken this much energy, counted from its power readings. For on/off devices like a water heater on a relay, or EV chargers, including chargers with current control. The device needs a live power reading. For EV chargers, you can choose an energy target with or without a linked car or battery reading; the energy includes charging losses. A water heater that is already hot or a car that stops accepting charge can leave the task short of its energy target. The task auto-disables once the deadline passes; run this card from a recurring Flow (for example every evening at 22:00) to set it up for the next night.
